discordGate.title: Not available in the browser yet
discordGate.body: Forza Events runs as a Discord Activity. Add the app in Discord, then open it from the App Launcher or a server voice channel.

legal.englishAuthoritative: The English text on this page is authoritative. UI translations elsewhere in the app do not replace these terms.
legal.footer: FORZA.EVENTS — community events for Forza Horizon, delivered as a Discord Activity.

browserSignIn.title: Community events for Forza Horizon
browserSignIn.subtitle: Browse races, join convoys, and host events — synced with your Discord servers.
browserSignIn.disclaimer: We use Discord only to identify you and list your servers. No password is stored here.
